hardening: This review establishes proposed source controls only. Do not equate offline fixtures or service templates to installed cross-UID DAC, actual sudo/polkit/ACL/capability/inherited-FD restrictions, serial exclusivity, systemd/seccomp/egress support, Proxmox compatibility or VM no-NIC qualification. Those operator observations remain NOT RUN and need separate authorization.

Keep the broker credential outside the submitting UID; VM.Console inherently grants broader PVE console authority than action names. safe_account group checks are necessary but do not prove absence of non-group administrative paths. Do not activate under the current broad Nexus identity.

Deploy only from independently reviewed root-controlled source/interpreter/dependencies and retain independent source/CA/grant fingerprints. This user-writable candidate repository is not itself an enforced isolation boundary.

The infrastructure journal hash chain is unkeyed local integrity evidence and has no external antirollback guarantee. Protected service-owned storage and independently retained checkpoints remain necessary; no arbitrary reset/retry is implemented.

Phase2 observe.py dynamically executes external /home/nexus/.local/bin/g6k-pve164-readonly, whose source/credential/TLS implementation is outside the frozen repository and deliberately not opened or run. Its constant tls_verified=true output does not independently establish that helper behavior. Record this as an external implementation coverage limitation, not a vulnerability.
A compromised guest can fabricate bounded observations; guest_report_untrusted=true and independent PVE/operator identity checks correctly avoid treating those reports as attestation.
